newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices rise on overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices rise on overseas demand.

text.p: Bangladesh tea prices rose on overseas demand at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.
Buyers for Poland and Pakistan were active, lifting bold and large brokens teas. Local buyers including blenders were also active, buying mostly good liquoring grades.
The average price was 57.75 taka per kg, up 1.31 taka from the previous sale.
Some 832,552 kg of teas were sold at the auction. The next sale will be held on July 1 with an offer of 1.0 million kg.
